children: American Water Works Company, Inc. (NYSE:AWK) is advancing mergers and infrastructure: a non‑unanimous settlement with Essential Utilities awaits Pennsylvania PUC approval, the Tennessee unit will issue a PFAS bill credit, AWK closed the $34.5M Neosho acquisition, and California began Lincoln Oaks upgrades.
: An ALJ interim order (Aug 28, 2026) reports a non‑unanimous settlement between American Water Works (AWK) and Essential Utilities in the Pennsylvania PUC merger review; pending PPUC approval.
: American Water Works (AWK) said Tennessee unit will issue a PFAS-related bill credit to customers, citing regulatory approval and ongoing drinking-water compliance and recent capital investments.
: American Water Works (AWK) closed June 24, 2026 acquisition of Neosho water and wastewater systems for $34.5M, adding ~5,400 water and 5,400 wastewater customers and 25 employees.
: AWK’s California subsidiary launched the Lincoln Oaks water main replacement in Citrus Heights to relocate mains to streets, replace aging pipes and install individual meters for local customers.
